reviews.text: Tbh I don’t actually use it as a dairy since I can’t remember the days that pass, but I do love it as a writing space because you can like change the size of the words. The notes app font is so damn big, and for me (since I’m in school) I worry that I’ll write in docs and it’ll accidentally be on my school account (embarrassing) so this is rly helpful actually. The formats nice and I like that the password is like constantly there even when you leave the app for a sec. I do wish you could use italics and bold font tho (without premium and all) but still pretty good without it anyways. So much joys it’s rly helped me follow my dreams and finally write down what I think on without worrying about privacy and all. So id recommend 💯 thanks for helping my dream

reviews.title: It exists.
reviews.text:
This app possesses the bare minimum of diary app functionality: it's a diary with a password. There is no formatting or customization, and the free font selection is extremely limited. In my case, yeah, hard pass.

The wording on the buttons and messages within the app is very weird (recall the foreign developer). The interface, too, is odd—annoyingly so. But if you want a really boring-looking app and you don’t care what the buttons look like, go ahead.
